Ai, Georgia
Ai
is an
unincorporated community
in
Gilmer County
,
Georgia
, United States.
A post office called Ai was established in 1920, and remained in operation until 1932.
[
2
]
The community was named after
Ai
, a place mentioned in the Hebrew Bible.

3

Ai was located inland away from the railroad.
